slices.focus: A lot has been shifting lately, and one thing at work finally felt like it moved
slices.summary: Monica trains two newer inspectors on the chronic-offender brief and a tenant-contact script to standardize how the team documents retaliation fears and access problems before reinspections, marking a shift from personal vigilance to building shared team judgment and reducing her sole ownership of the corridor process.
open_loops: Shadow first few high-friction reinspections with new inspectors
Hold follow-up meeting on one-strong-one-uncertain notes
Watch for unsolicited quality in file notes
decisions: Monica is a frontline housing code supervisor now training her team on chronic-offender briefs and tenant-contact script
